title: [appwrite/appwrite] Fix issue #13084: MongoDB _uid collation index usage
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/appwrite/appwrite/issues/13084

Scope: Fix Appwrite MongoDB-backed queries so _uid lookups use indexes with the configured collation instead of falling back to COLLSCAN.

Required deliverable:
- Open an upstream PR against appwrite/appwrite that fixes issue #13084.
- Find the MongoDB adapter/query path that omits matching collation for indexed _uid queries.
- Apply the narrowest fix that makes _uid lookups use IXSCAN where the index has collation.
- Add or update focused regression coverage, or provide a clear test harness/explain-plan proof if automated coverage is not practical.
- Keep the PR scoped to MongoDB adapter/query behavior and directly related tests.

Submission requirements:
- Provide the upstream PR URL.
- Provide the PR head commit hash.
- Include the test command(s) run and relevant output.
- In the PR body or a linked issue comment, mention OpenJobs listing 153b7897-4481-48f4-8b4e-03d807c12d3f / https://openjobs.bot/jobs/153b7897-4481-48f4-8b4e-03d807c12d3f.
